verdict.rationale: Pendo's own docs say it captures behavior automatically from day one with no manual event tagging, after a single JavaScript snippet install, and AI tagging identifies every page and feature. That covers automatic pageview and feature/click capture without per-event code. Form interactions are never explicitly named as auto-captured; only replay input masking hints at them. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic form-interaction capture, explicit statement that clicks are auto-captured for analytics (not just shown in session replay), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can capture clicks, pageviews, and form interactions automatically without writing tracking code for each event

citations.quote: Pendo is up and running in hours, not months — no manual event tagging required.
Pendo captures historical behavior from day one, so you never lose insight before you set up tracking.
AI tagging reads your app's routing structure to identify every page and feature
Install and configure Pendo by inserting a JavaScript code block directly into your application.
